title: Why JavaScript Is Needed
learningObjectives: Understand limitations of HTML and CSS

content.explanation: HTML can display information and CSS can style it, but neither can make decisions, validate user input, perform calculations, or communicate intelligently with servers. JavaScript fills this gap. It allows websites to validate forms, update content dynamically, call APIs, and react instantly to user actions. This ability transformed websites from static documents into interactive applications.
content.example: JavaScript checks whether an email address contains required characters before sending data to a server.
content.analogy: HTML is the body, CSS is clothing, and JavaScript is the brain.
